description: Lists the downloadable kits, checklists, worksheets and scripts published on jwatte.com, newest linking article first, optionally filtered by keywords. Each entry has the file name, title, link, file type, size in bytes and the articles that link it. Includes the total count and next offset; 1 to 25 entries per page.

offset.description: Number of entries before this page, matching the previous next_offset value.

search.description: Optional keywords that must all appear in the title, file name, summary or linking article titles, e.g. "mcp". Empty means all downloads.

name: list_downloads
